flagged.title: Algorithms: Flowcharts, Pseudocode and Constructs
flagged.reason: At 02:56, the video states as a blanket rule that loop-back arrows curve back from the 'No' exit of a decision diamond, which will lead students to label condition-controlled flowchart loops backwards and lose marks.

mark_affecting.quote: In fact, when you see a loop in a flowchart, you'll see an arrow curving right back upward from the no exit of this very diamond to an earlier step.
